description: VS Code settings for Claude customization on Modular RAG Framework.

PostToolUse.description: Lint Python code after any file write. Checks for syntax (E), undefined names (F), and import order (I).

permissions.description: Granular permission strategy: denylist (always block) + three tiers (dontAsk > acceptEdits > ask_before_edit).

denylists.reason: Secrets - environment variables, API keys, credentials

noAskPaths.reason: Test scope - zero friction, creation encouraged

autoPaths.reason: Domain module - auto-accept new chunkers, parsers, processors
Domain module - auto-accept new retrievers, rerankers
Domain module - auto-accept new generators, prompts

restrictedPaths.reason: Protocol definitions - breaking changes impact entire framework
Safety/Security critical - PII, injection guards, policies

futureHooks.description: Reserved for V2+ validation patterns. Uncomment when ready to enable.

PostToolUse.description: RESERVED: Detect cross-domain imports (e.g., retrieval/ importing from generation/)
RESERVED: Verify Protocol implementations have conformance tests
RESERVED: Check that lazy imports are used for heavy deps

parallelization.description: Parallel execution orchestration for multi-task workflows (V2+ feature, partially enabled in V1).
parallelization.notes: V1 supports parallel tool calls (search, read_file). Full agentic parallelization in V2+.

taskDecomposition.description: How to break down work into independent parallel tasks.

patterns.name: analysis_tasks
patterns.description: Run analysis on retrieval, generation, security components in parallel
examples: parallel-feature-analysis skill uses: analyze_retrieval() | analyze_generation() | analyze_security()

patterns.name: retriever_execution
patterns.description: Parallel execution of multiple retrievers (vector + BM25), then fuse results
examples: HybridRetriever: vector_retriever.retrieve() | bm25_retriever.retrieve() in parallel, then RRF fusion
patterns.dependencies: Fusion waits for both retrievers to complete

patterns.name: test_execution
patterns.description: Run unit, contract, integration tests in parallel (safe - no side effects)
patterns.dependencies: None within scopes - can parallelize fully

patterns.name: file_operations
patterns.description: Multiple file reads/writes in parallel (when no dependencies)
examples: Read multiple doc files in parallel for ingestion
patterns.dependencies: Order-independent reads are safe to parallelize

streamExecution.description: How parallel streams coordinate and merge results.

stages.example: Start retrieval on vec, bm25, graph in parallel

stages.description: Tasks run independently, emit results to shared context
stages.example: Each retriever writes results to context['retriever_results']
RRF fusion merges vec + bm25 results

stages.description: Final aggregation and return to caller

contextSharing.description: How parallel tasks share state and context.

example.code_pattern: context = {}; asyncio.gather(vec_retrieve(context), bm25_retrieve(context)); return fuse(context['vec'], context['bm25'])

contextSharing.thread_safety: Use asyncio for coroutines (cooperative multitasking, no GIL issues) or threading.Lock for thread parallelism
contextSharing.data_isolation: Each parallel task gets own input, contributes to shared output dict by key

dependencyResolution.description: How to express and resolve task dependencies.

patterns.description: No dependencies - run all in parallel
patterns.example: Multi-retriever fusion where vec and bm25 don't depend on each other

patterns.description: Task B depends on Task A result - run sequential
patterns.syntax: retrieval_result = await retriever.retrieve(); ranking_result = await reranker.rerank(retrieval_result)

patterns.description: Some tasks parallel (A,B independent), then dependent (C waits for A,B)
patterns.example: Vec + BM25 in parallel, then RRF fusion waits for both
patterns.syntax: vec, bm25 = await asyncio.gather(vec_ret(), bm25_ret()); fusion = fuse(vec, bm25)

patterns.description: One initiator spawns multiple tasks, waits for all to complete
patterns.example: Query parallelized across multiple components, results aggregated
patterns.syntax: results = await asyncio.gather(*[component.execute() for component in components])

failureHandling.description: How parallel tasks handle failures and timeouts.

strategies.description: If any task fails, cancel others and raise error
strategies.use_case: Critical path - one failure = entire operation fails

strategies.description: If one retriever fails, continue with others
strategies.use_case: Hybrid retrieval - one source failure not fatal
strategies.implementation: Wrap task in try/except, return partial results

strategies.description: Cancel task after timeout, use cached/fallback result
strategies.use_case: Slow services - don't block entire pipeline

performanceOptimization.description: How to measure and optimize parallel execution.

metrics.measurement: Trace start/end times for each task

optimization_tactics.description: Ensure parallel tasks have similar runtime
optimization_tactics.example: Don't parallelize fast (1ms) + slow (100ms) tasks - limits speedup
Share simple types (strings, numbers) not large objects

optimization_tactics.description: Process multiple items in single parallel task
optimization_tactics.example: Batch embed 100 queries in one task vs 100 parallel embed tasks

v2PlusPlanning.description: Full multi-agent orchestration reserved for V2+.
features: Agentic task coordination (multiple agents, task routing)
Dynamic workload distribution (load balancing across agents)
Resource management (CPU, memory, I/O quotas per agent)
v2PlusPlanning.current_scope_v1: V1 uses basic parallelization (retriever fusion, parallel file ops). Full multi-agent framework in V2.

notes.ruffConfig: Ruff settings use defaults (see pyproject.toml for customization).
notes.permissionStrategy: 3-tier granular approach: denylist (always block) → noAskPaths (dontAsk, zero friction) → autoPaths (acceptEdits, auto-accept) → restrictedPaths (ask_before_edit, confirm before).
notes.tier1_noAsk: tests/, examples/, docs/ - zero requests, creation encouraged.
notes.tier2_autoPaths: Domain modules (ingestion, retrieval, generation, eval, memory) - auto-accept new implementations, no friction.
notes.tier3_restrictedPaths: Contracts, orchestration, security, adapters - ask confirmation before any edit to preserve architecture.
notes.denylists: Always blocked: secrets, production configs, architecture rules, V2-V5 reserved namespaces.
notes.bypassPermissions: Always false - this is the governance pattern.
notes.futureValidation: To enable V2+ hooks (cross-domain imports, conformance tests, lazy imports), set 'enabled': true in futureHooks.
notes.moreInfo: See .claude/.instructions.md, .claude/rules/*.md, and CLAUDE.md block 09 for full guidelines.
